title: Mr Bloom passed on out of the clanking noises through the gallery on to the landing
html_source:
Bloom’s movement in early Aeolus is evocative of Odysseus on a boat, the different noises, the different jobs of different crew and a variety of sights and sounds as he moves vertically through the decks of the paper works.

Odysseus kept the lot ticking over for 9 days and nights before he succumbed to being knackered.
